SpaceX llevará a cabo el 15º lanzamiento de Starship y Super Heavy, con uno de los objetivos más ambiciosos del programa: intentar atrapar por primera vez la Starship con los brazos de la torre. La misión despegará desde Starbase y buscará recuperar ambas etapas, con el regreso de Super Heavy tras la separación y, posteriormente, el retorno de Starship para intentar su captura.

snippet.title: Ramlila Maidan Rally  सफल रही? INDIA Bloc की Vote Chori Rally और Amit Shah का जवाब
snippet.description:
Saam Daam Dand Bhed Playlist - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLLtf3Hz_WUGA
Was the INDIA bloc’s Ramlila Maidan rally a success? On November 1, opposition leaders gathered in Delhi to demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged ‘vote chori’ and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of voter lists. The Congress had claimed up to 10 lakh people would attend, while Delhi Police expected around 50,000. BJP MP Sambit Patra said thousands of chairs were empty, and Amit Shah told the opposition to get ready for five more years out of power. In this clip from Episode 12, the panel weighs the competing claims.
